mapper.sql: id, requester_user_id, request_type, consent_type, scope_code, description, status, handled_by_user_id, handled_at, decision_code, decision_reason, retention_decision, created_at, updated_at
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO privacy_request ( requester_user_id, request_type, consent_type, scope_code, description, status, created_at, updated_at ) VALUES ( #{requesterUserId}, #{requestType}, #{consentType}, #{scopeCode}, #{description}, 'OPEN', NOW(), NOW() )
mapper.select: SELECT FROM privacy_request WHERE id = #{id} FOR UPDATE
SELECT COUNT(1) FROM privacy_request WHERE requester_user_id = #{requesterUserId}

SELECT COUNT(1) FROM privacy_request
WHERE status = #{status}
mapper.update: UPDATE privacy_request SET status = #{status}, handled_by_user_id = #{actorUserId}, handled_at = NOW(), decision_code = #{decisionCode}, decision_reason = #{decisionReason}, retention_decision = #{retentionDecision}, updated_at = NOW() WHERE id = #{id} AND status IN ('OPEN', 'PROCESSING') AND EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM user actor WHERE actor.id = #{actorUserId} AND actor.level = 0 )
